entries.title: Galatians 1:1
segments: Paul, an apostle (not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),

entries.title: Galatians 1:2
segments: and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia.

entries.title: Galatians 1:3
segments: Grace [be] to you, and peace from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Galatians 1:4
segments: who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil world according to the will of God and our Father,

entries.title: Galatians 1:5
segments: to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Galatians 1:6
segments: I marvel that you so soon are being moved away from Him who called you into [the] grace of Christ, to another gospel,

entries.title: Galatians 1:7
segments: which is not another, but some are troubling you, and desiring to pervert the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:8
segments: But even if we or an angel from Heaven preach a gospel to you beside what we preached to you, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:9
segments: As we said before, and now I say again, If anyone preaches a gospel to you beside what you have received, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:10
segments: For now do I persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I yet pleased men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:11
segments: And, brothers, I make known to you the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

entries.title: Galatians 1:12
segments: For I did not receive it from man, nor was I taught [it] except by a revelation of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:13
segments: For you heard my manner of life when [I was] in Judaism, that I persecuted the church of God with surpassing [zeal], and ravaged it.

entries.title: Galatians 1:14
segments: And I progressed in Judaism beyond many contemporaries in my race, being much more a zealot of the traditions of my fathers.

entries.title: Galatians 1:15
segments: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and having called [me] by His grace,

entries.title: Galatians 1:16
segments: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the nations, immediately I did not confer with flesh and blood;

entries.title: Galatians 1:17
segments: Nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those apostles before me, but I went into Arabia and returned again to Damascus.

entries.title: Galatians 1:18
segments: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

entries.title: Galatians 1:19
segments: But I saw no other of the apostles, except James the Lord's brother.

entries.title: Galatians 1:20
segments: And what I write to you, behold, before God, I do not lie.

entries.title: Galatians 1:21
segments: Then I went into the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,

entries.title: Galatians 1:22
segments: and was unknown by face to the churches of Judea in Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:23
segments: But only they were hearing that he who then persecuted us, now preaches the faith which he once ravaged.

entries.title: Galatians 1:24
segments: And they glorified God in me.
